integrity: An actual finite acyclic-matching certificate and its standalone Python verifier are included. Independent scientific audit has not been performed. Earlier graph clique counts and conference-graph context are credited, not claimed as new.
limitations: The theorem concerns the single Paley graph of order seventeen. The wedge decomposition is not claimed equivariantly. The affine module and all subgroup quotient computations are rational; no integral quotient or all-Paley-order classification follows.
title: The Paley-seventeen clique complex: sixteen two-spheres and an affine homology module
